en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-27 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) narrated that the Blessed the Sublime God said,

“O son of Adam! You did not treat me justly. Do not let other people’s sins make you forget your own sins. Do not let other people’s God-given Blessings make you forget the blessings that God has granted you. Do not make the people disappointed with God’s Mercy, while you are hopeful of receiving it yourself.”
